purpose: Isolate reasons exact-pose seeds are rejected, then test the smallest evidence-led search or representation change.
frozen_requirements: Original tabletop-transfer-v1 positions, tilts, tolerances, full-cycle assembly and panel requirements remain the acceptance reference.

stage_1.sampling: Same deterministic radical-inverse sequence, bounds and attachment representation as released pose_seeds.py
measurements: Count each geometric screen independently among in-bounds finite samples
Separate actual full-cycle assembly and strict class conditions from robustness margins
Count one-screen removals and removal of robustness margins
Check branch and target-order consistency and target/global transmission separately
Independently verify representative dyads, including rejected candidates

stage_2: Record controlled follow-up settings before execution, guided by stage-1 findings. Label changed search representation separately from relaxed design requirements. Do not promote a relaxed result as an original-brief success.
budget: Local CPU numerical work. No model training. Bound each additional sampling or optimization comparison and retain unsuccessful outcomes.
decision: Recommend the smallest justified next change; a bounded failure does not prove infeasibility. This case remains development data.
